To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of CSIR NEIST to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting the CSIR NEIST Security Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the North East Institute of Science and Technology (CSIR NEIST), located in Jorhat, Assam, for hiring eligible research and administrative support personnel.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies available for the Security Officer post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Security Officer position under advertisement number 08/2026-REC, classified under unreserved category.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary scale for the CSIR NEIST Security Officer position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Security Officer post will receive a salary in Level-07 ranging from Rs. 44,900 to Rs. 1,42,400 per month along with standard allowances.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit the online application form?
faq.answer: The last date to successfully submit the online application form for the CSIR NEIST Security Officer recruitment is 27 October 2026.

faq.question: Q5. Who is eligible to apply for the Security Officer position?
faq.answer: Candidates must be Ex-Servicemen JCO (Subedar or higher rank) or hold equivalent rank in other Para-military forces with a minimum of 10 years of security experience.

faq.question: Q6. What is the maximum age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Security Officer position is 35 years, with age relaxations applicable as per Government of India rules for Ex-Servicemen.

faq.question: Q7. How much is the application fee for General and OBC candidates?
faq.answer: General, OBC, and EWS candidates are required to pay an application fee of Rs. 500, whereas SC, ST, ESM, and women candidates are completely exempted from fee payment.

faq.question: Q8. What mode of application is accepted by CSIR NEIST?
faq.answer: Candidates must submit their applications exclusively through the online mode by visiting the official website of CSIR NEIST before the stipulated deadline.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for the Security Officer post?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises a physical and personality assessment test which is qualifying in nature, followed by a written test consisting of Paper-I and Paper-II.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I access the official website to apply?
faq.answer: Eligible and interested candidates can access the official web portal to apply online by visiting the official CSIR NEIST website at https://www.neist.res.in.
